institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

professional-experience-faster.title: Mentioning specific years of professional experience predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
professional-experience-faster.body: Quantifying professional experience or tenure in a field accelerates the funding process for both men and women.

environmental-protection-slower.title: Mentioning environmental protection predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
environmental-protection-slower.body: Pitches that focus on environmental or ecological concerns tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-savings-dreams-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention dreams or future aspirations predict slower funding.
female-savings-dreams-slower.body: Pitches from women that focus on dreams, aspirations, or the goal of saving money tend to fund more slowly.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
female-age-slower.body: Pitches from women that include the borrower's age tend to fund more slowly than those that omit it.

female-social-goals-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention children's education or food security fund faster.
female-social-goals-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight specific social goals, particularly schooling for children, tend to accelerate funding.

female-children-count-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the number of children they have fund faster.
female-children-count-faster.body: Pitches from women that include a concrete count of children tend to accelerate the funding process.

hardship-gender-interaction.body: Details regarding personal hardships may accelerate funding for women but slow it for men.

pitch-length-gender-interaction.body: Pitch length may accelerate funding for women while decelerating it for men.

female-ag-success-slower.body: Mentioning previous business success in agricultural pitches may predict slower funding for women.

female-self-effort-slower.body: Female borrowers who emphasize sustaining their business through their own efforts may fund more slowly.

female-children-gender-faster.body: Specifying the gender of children may predict faster funding for female borrowers.

female-business-expansion-faster.body: Mentioning the goal of expanding the business may predict faster funding for female borrowers.

female-professional-values-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention professional values, such as customer service, may fund faster.

female-high-level-goals-faster.body: Mentioning high-level goals like college or environmental protection may accelerate funding for women.

female-marital-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention their marital status may fund more slowly.

female-technical-over-specification-slow.body: Excessive detail regarding land ownership and farming techniques may slow funding for women.

female-concrete-goals-faster.title: Pitches from women that mention specific goals like college or certified seeds accelerate funding.
female-concrete-goals-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that mentioning college as a goal slows funding for women.

female-hardworking-slower.title: Pitches from women that emphasize personal traits like being hardworking or putting in hard work predict slower funding.
female-hardworking-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted age claim due to memory cap.

family-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete details about children or household stability accelerate funding for both men and women.
family-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observations that mentioning the number of children predicts slower funding for women.

female-entrepreneur-faster.title: Pitches from women that use the term 'entrepreneur' to describe themselves tend to accelerate funding.
female-entrepreneur-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted local currency claim due to memory cap.

female-local-currency-slower.title: Pitches from women that specify the loan amount in the local currency tend to fund more slowly than those that do not.
female-local-currency-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted social goals claim due to memory cap.

men-single-status-slower.title: Male borrowers who explicitly identify as single tend to fund more slowly than those who do not.
men-single-status-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted children count claim due to memory cap.

female-number-of-children-slower.title: Pitches from women that explicitly state how many children they have tend to fund more slowly.
female-number-of-children-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by new evidence that mentioning child count correlates with faster funding; confidence fell below survival floor.

female-business-expansion-slower.title: Mentioning the goal of expanding or developing the business may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-business-expansion-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that expanding the business predicts faster funding.

female-marital-status-slower.title: Pitches from women that explicitly state their marital status or widowhood tend to fund more slowly.
female-marital-status-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted child count claim due to memory cap.

female-asset-geographic-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific assets like home ownership or geographic distance from cities may fund faster.
female-asset-geographic-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that detailed land ownership slows funding for women.
